(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define bg
               (mode-list (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))) (at g r c))))
             (define comps (objects-multicolor g bg))
             (define (cell-color p) (at g (first p) (second p)))
             (define (colors-of obj)
               (remove-duplicates (map cell-color (obj-cells obj))))
             (define singles (filter (lambda (o) (= (length (colors-of o)) 1)) comps))
             (define templates (filter (lambda (o) (> (length (colors-of o)) 1)) comps))
             (define (count-color cells color)
               (count-if (lambda (p) (= (cell-color p) color)) cells))
             (define (anchor-color? color cells)
               (let ((cnt (count-color cells color)))
                 (for/or ((o singles))
                         (and
                           (= (cell-color (first (obj-cells o))) color)
                           (= (obj-size o) cnt)))))
             (define (standalone-cells color cnt)
               (apply append
                      (cons (list)
                            (map obj-cells
                                 (filter (lambda (o)
                                           (and
                                             (= (cell-color (first (obj-cells o)))
                                                color)
                                             (= (obj-size o) cnt)))
                                         singles)))))
             (define (put gg r c v) (if (in-bounds? r c h w) (set-cell gg r c v) gg))
             (for/fold ((out g))
               ((tmpl templates))
               (define cells (obj-cells tmpl))
               (define colors (colors-of tmpl))
               (define anchor-colors
                 (filter (lambda (color) (anchor-color? color cells)) colors))
               (define (anchor? p) (member (cell-color p) anchor-colors))
               (define anchor-cells (filter anchor? cells))
               (define non-anchor-cells (filter (lambda (p) (not (anchor? p))) cells))
               (define stamped? #f)
               (define stamped
                 (for/fold ((gg out))
                   ((ac anchor-cells))
                   (define color (cell-color ac))
                   (define cnt (count-color cells color))
                   (for/fold ((gg2 gg))
                     ((target (standalone-cells color cnt)))
                     (define dr (- (first target) (first ac)))
                     (define dc (- (second target) (second ac)))
                     (define anchors-ok
                       (for/and ((ap anchor-cells))
                                (let ((nr (+ (first ap) dr))
                                      (nc (+ (second ap) dc)))
                                  (and
                                    (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                                    (= (at g nr nc) (cell-color ap))))))
                     (define fills-bg
                       (for/or ((p non-anchor-cells))
                               (let ((nr (+ (first p) dr))
                                     (nc (+ (second p) dc)))
                                 (and (in-bounds? nr nc h w) (= (at g nr nc) bg)))))
                     (if (and anchors-ok fills-bg)
                         (begin
                           (set! stamped? #t)
                           (for/fold ((gg3 gg2))
                             ((p cells))
                             (put gg3 (+ (first p) dr) (+ (second p) dc) (cell-color p))))
                         gg2))))
               (if stamped?
                   (for/fold ((gg stamped))
                     ((p non-anchor-cells))
                     (if (= (count-color cells (cell-color p)) 1)
                         (put gg (first p) (second p) bg)
                         gg))
                   stamped))))))
